title: Accessibility sprint: Organic Chemistry I

brief: A student accommodation request found problems in {faculty}'s online Organic Chemistry I: auto-captions on 24 lecture videos, chemical diagrams with no alt text, and scanned PDFs a screen reader can't read. The course has to pass an accessibility review before term starts in four weeks.
